description: Variants of the grants suite's export store (core conformance/grants_vectors.py _export_vectors), each verified by the Python reference verify_evidence_events; the TypeScript SDK agrees on every case but prefix-empty-no-resource (a use without a resource under an empty resource prefix, which it lets through). A case may hold the NA's key history (history, in place of na_public_keys) and a retention checkpoint (checkpoint). spelling_cases: integers written 1.0, which the reference refuses as non-canonical and both SDKs read as the integer, with the SDKs' answers. Left out, where both SDKs differ from the reference alike: a quarantined use with a field the reference does not know, and a time written +00:00. expected.failures: (store_sequence, reason), unique and sorted; lines index the pool.
